video_goal: Demonstrate how to assemble, fit, and pair a Fi GPS collar on an Australian Shepherd.
required_subjects_and_props: Silver Fi GPS module, compatible nylon collar band, blue merle Australian Shepherd, smartphone with Fi app

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands place a silver rectangular Fi GPS module and a heavy-duty nylon collar band side-by-side on a wooden table.
Hands pick up the components and slide the metal end-link of the collar band into the side groove of the Fi GPS module.
Thumbs press firmly down on the metal link until it snaps flush into the Fi module casing.
A fluffy blue merle Australian Shepherd sits patiently while hands present the fully assembled Fi collar to the dog.
Hands part the thick fur around the Australian Shepherd's neck and wrap the nylon collar band around it.
Hands push the two ends of the plastic quick-release buckle together until they snap shut.
Two fingers slide between the collar band and the dog's neck, lifting slightly to show a large gap indicating it is too loose.
Hands unbuckle the collar, slide the plastic tri-glide adjuster to shorten the nylon band, and re-buckle it around the dog's neck.
Two fingers slide snugly between the collar and the dog's neck, demonstrating a proper fit beneath the thick fur.
One hand holds a smartphone displaying the Fi app interface, while the index finger taps the 'Activate Collar' button.
The smartphone screen displays a spinning loading circle, which transitions into a large green checkmark.
The LED light on the silver Fi GPS module resting on the Australian Shepherd's neck flashes blue, confirming the active connection.
